Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a jellyfish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about “horrors beyond it's comprehension” and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a lone figure, JASON, a young man with a fishing rod, stands at the water's edge. He casts his line into the ocean, waiting for a bite. Suddenly, his line starts to tug, and he pulls in a massive jellyfish.

JASON
(excitedly)
Yes! Gotcha!

Jason carefully lifts the jellyfish out of the water and holds it above his head. The jellyfish, a translucent creature with a pulsing umbrella-like body, looks up at Jason with a mixture of fear and confusion.

JASON
(smiling)
You're a beauty, aren't you?

Jason holds the jellyfish up to the sky, and it begins to quiver and shake. The sun starts to set, casting a golden glow over the scene.

JASON
(whispering)
It's time for the eclipse.

Jason carefully positions the jellyfish so that it faces the sun, and the creature's body begins to glow with an otherworldly light. The jellyfish's tentacles start to writhe and twist, as if in agony.

JASON
(whispering)
Look at you, staring at the void.

The jellyfish's gaze becomes fixed on the sun, and it begins to speak in a voice that is both ancient and eternal.

JELLYFISH
(in a Lovecraftian monologue)
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn... I see the horrors beyond my comprehension. The void yawns open, revealing the abyssal depths of madness. The stars twist and writhe like living serpents. The fabric of reality is torn asunder, revealing the eldritch abominations that lurk beyond.

JASON
(backing away, frightened)
Whoa, easy there, little guy.

JELLYFISH
(continuing its monologue)
I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time. My existence is but a whisper in the wind, a momentary flicker of consciousness in an infinite expanse of nothingness. And yet, I am aware. I am aware of the crushing weight of existence, of the futility of my own existence.

JASON
(taking a step back, horrified)
Dude, I think you're having some kind of existential crisis.

JELLYFISH
(its voice rising to a fever pitch)
I am but a jellyfish, a creature of the sea, a mere speck in the grand scheme of things. And yet, I am aware of the abyssal horrors that lurk beyond the veil of reality. I am aware of the eldritch abominations that wait beyond the stars. I am aware of the crushing weight of existence, and I am consumed by it.

JASON
(backing away, tripping over his own feet)
Whoa, okay, I think I get it. You're having a crisis.

JELLYFISH
(its voice echoing through the void)
I am but a mere mortal, a fleeting moment in the grand tapestry of time. And yet, I am aware. I am aware of the horrors beyond my comprehension.

As the eclipse reaches its peak, the jellyfish's body begins to glow with an otherworldly light. Jason stumbles backward, tripping over his own feet, and falls to the ground.

JASON
(looking up at the jellyfish)
Dude, I think you're going to be okay.

JELLYFISH
(its voice fading into the void)
Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn...

The jellyfish's body begins to glow with an intense, blinding light, and Jason covers his eyes, stumbling backward in terror.

FADE TO BLACK.
